raw.details:
Overview

FRAME SHIFT – Shift Your Mindset. Animate Your Ideas.

Organized by the Animation Club, Madhav Institute of Technology & Science (MITS), Gwalior

FRAME SHIFT is a creative, hands-on event bringing together career development, music, and animation. Get ready to learn, collaborate, express yourself, and bring your ideas to life!

Event Highlights

Part A: Placement & HR Workshop
Gain valuable insights into placement preparation, HR interviews, communication skills, and professional development to help you prepare for your career.

Part B: Music Jamming Session
Unwind and connect through an engaging music jamming session featuring creativity, rhythm, and collaborative musical expression. Join fellow participants to enjoy the energy of music and celebrate creative talent.

Part C: Meme-to-Animation Challenge
Turn an ordinary meme into an extraordinary creation! Animate a static meme image or create a meme-based video using animation, video editing, and AI-powered creative tools.

Special Benefit for Every Participant

Get a FREE .XYZ domain!

Every participant will receive a .xyz domain, giving them an opportunity to establish their own identity on the web, showcase their creativity, and start building their digital presence.

Challenge Theme: Beyond the Frame

Take a static meme beyond its original form and bring it to life through animation. Think creatively, experiment with visual storytelling, and surprise everyone with your imagination.

Rules & Guidelines

  • Create an original meme-based animation or video.
  • AI tools are allowed as creative assistance.
  • Participants must contribute meaningful creative input to their submissions.
  • Copying complete animations or violating intellectual property rights is prohibited.
  • All submissions must be appropriate for a college event.
  • Participants must follow the organizers’ submission instructions and deadlines.

Judging Criteria

  • Creativity & Originality – 30%
  • Animation & Editing Quality – 25%
  • Humour & Storytelling – 20%
  • Theme Relevance – 15%
  • Overall Presentation – 10%

Eligibility & Participation

  • Open to eligible students and creative enthusiasts, subject to the registration criteria.
  • Mode: Offline
  • Registration Fee: Free
  • Free .XYZ Domain: One for every participant.
  • E-Certificate: For participants who complete the competition requirements.

Join FRAME SHIFT to explore career opportunities, enjoy a musical experience, unleash your creativity, and take your first step toward building your digital identity!
